_comment: THE fairness-band owner (TC-C, owner decision 3, 2026-10-18).  One band
definition for the /trade meter, sticky tray, balancers, the fairness
explanation, the Analyze Trade market lens / decision, Best Offers, the
package builder and the suggestions badge.  Python reads this file
(src/valuation_math/fairness_bands.py); the JS mirror
(frontend/lib/fairness-bands.js) is pinned to it by
tests/valuation_math/test_fairness_bands.py.
A gap is classified on the ADJUSTED package totals (raw + the active
package model's adjustment): relativePct = |gap| / larger adjusted side.
fair     |gap| < absoluteMinimum  OR  relativePct < slightPct
slight   relativePct < unfairPct
unfair   relativePct < lopsidedPct
lopsided otherwise
Derivation of the PROVISIONAL numbers: the KTC-era absolute meter bands
350 / 900 / 1800 expressed relative to a 10,000-point larger side (a
typical one-star package), i.e. 3.5% / 9% / 18%, so a star trade reads
the same as before while a bench trade is no longer graded on a star's
scale.  The absolute minimum 250 is the tighter of the two even bands the
repo already used (market lens 256, meter 350), rounded.  Every number is
a PRIOR until validated against a defined target; q = 0.78 is not a band
and is never modified here.
